title: fix(plugin-chatbot): a reloaded answer draws a redrawn chart once, keeping the last visualize_data result per chartId
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNgJrQDxaUNx2so1ektgf6A)_
Fixes #34716

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfrh8TiPJf1i2kMSoa

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：聊天历史读取（`extractCharts` 的 `visualize_data` 结果路径）在同一条消息里按结果信封顶层的 `chartId` 合并：同一 `chartId` 只画一张图，用最后一次结果的图，放在第一次出现的位置。
- **为什么改**：模型在一次回答里重画图表时，实时对话只剩一张；刷新页面从历史重载后，被替换的那张又回来，用户看到两张图。
- **风险与回滚**：低。没有 `chartId` 的结果（旧历史、其它生产者）逐字节照旧；从不跨消息合并；`data-chart` 部件路径（实时流）不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/toolResultParsers.ts`（`extractCharts` 中 `resultIndexByChartId` 一段，`chartFromToolResult` 改为同时返回 `chartId`）；`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/mapMessages.chartIdDedupe-34716.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/mapMessages.chartIdDedupe-34716.test.ts`，预期 7 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `chartFromToolResult` now returns the chart together with the envelope's top-level `chartId` (only a non-empty string counts as an id).
- `extractCharts`, on the results path only: within ONE message, a result whose `chartId` was already seen replaces that earlier chart in place (last descriptor, first result's `textOffset`). A result without a `chartId` is pushed exactly as before. The map is local to one call, so nothing is merged across messages. The `data-chart` part branch is unchanged (still preferred whenever the message has one).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` patch.

## Tests

New file `mapMessages.chartIdDedupe-34716.test.ts` (7 tests), per the card's Acceptance:

- same `chartId` twice in one message: one chart, last descriptor, first offset;
- different `chartId`s: two charts at their own offsets;
- a redraw keeps the first chart's position among other charts;
- CONTROL: results without `chartId` (same descriptor twice) give two charts at their own offsets, as today;
- same `chartId` in two messages: one chart in each;
- legacy string `content` (unanchored): the redraw collapses, no offset;
- `data-chart` parts present: parts win, every part kept, results ignored.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's premise was re-measured on base `c513d62a` before coding: `extractCharts` pushed every `visualize_data` hit into `fromResults`, and no `chartId` reader existed under `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src` (`grep -rn chartId` returned nothing).
- If the LAST result for a `chartId` is unrenderable (no series), it is skipped by the existing descriptor narrowing and the earlier chart stays. Noted, not pinned.

## Verification

All readings at head `59e6bcaa`, in worktree `objectstack-issue-34716`.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-chatbot/` under the verify lock: `Test Files 102 passed (102)`, `Tests 1035 passed (1035)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project includes `src/**/*.test.ts`): VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, the collapse lookup)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `resultIndexByChartId.get(chartId)` lookup with a constant `undefined` (anchor 1 to 0, blob a5f650e0 to 8eb18380). The suite imports `../mapMessages` from source, so no build sits between the edit and the run. Result: 3 failed, 4 passed. The three same-`chartId` tests went red; CONTROL, different ids, two messages and the `data-chart` path stayed green. Restore: blob back to a5f650e0, which equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>
